look.why: A warm savanna-sunset orange, the complement of the cool grey skin and the colour of the dry grass it walks through.

size.measure: trunk tip to tail, about 6 m for a big adult (general knowledge; ADW gives shoulder heights of 2.2–4 m)

habitat.text: Savannas, woodlands, forests and even deserts across Africa, from sea level up to 4,000 m.

diet.text: Leaves, grass, fruit, bark and roots, munched nearly all day. Plus about 190 litres of water!

facts.text: Elephants seem to call each other by name: a 2024 study found rumbles meant for one elephant only.
Herds are led by the biggest, boss female, and up to 70 family members follow her.
